name: At the Time
tagline: You'll let a good move look bad, and not say a word.
epigraph: Rye, sugar, bitters, peel. The coffee is in the ice, and arrives later.
glassware: heavy double old-fashioned glass (about 350 ml), one large block of coffee ice
language_row: Wren's checks on v3: title block, whoYouAre (cut from 194 to about 150 words) and yours swap-tested against the family (in her turns); lint 0 errors, 4 warnings (gendered pronouns in yours 1–3, Cedd Moses, a historical person; "by the late 1990s", the page's own date frame: all accepted by Wren in r4). ✓

names_note: *At the Time* (2–1, round 4: Tomás, Hester; Wren voted *Still in Play*), over *Still in Play* (Wren's pick), *In Good Time* (Tomás's pick until the vote), *On Purpose*, *Looked Wrong* and *Not Yet*. Picks were held until the vote.
open_items: The barrel-proof rye's 60% is a style value, unsourced; strength proven across 55–68% in two water stops (15 ml / 25 ml), not above 68% (Tomás).

After serve the drink waters down below the built strength band after about 20 ml of melt, as any Old-Fashioned on a block does; coffee and orange values unsourced, no melt times given (no book gives a rate).
The coffee's freezing toward the centre of the block is Tomás's inference from *Liquid Intelligence*'s clear-ice pages, kept out of guest text.
